thread:
nina.sales: Quick help needed — ClearLedger POC failing behind BlueCoat proxy. They see intermittent 502, 429 and ReadTimeouts. Blocker for demo.

pat-eng: Paste SDK init + proxy config. 502 often proxy mangling chunked uploads. 429 could be NAT egress.

nina.sales: Snippet from customer:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'], timeout=10, max_retries=3)
session = client.session
session.proxies.update({'https': 'http://proxy.bluecoat.corp:8080'})
resp = client.generate(model='rw-embed-1', prompt='...')
```
Errors: requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout, occasional 502, lots of 429 in proxy logs.

rita-devex: Which SDK version? 0.9 had chunked header ordering bug behind some proxies. If on 0.9.0 advise upgrade to 0.9.3. Also try setting Connection: close if proxy mishandles keep-alive.

omar-sre: If requests never show in our front logs it's proxy dropping. We can provision a temp hostname with dedicated egress IP and bump the per-key window for trial. Need expected qps and window.

lee-security: Confirm whether their proxy does TLS inspection. If so headers/SNI can be rewritten causing resets. We can offer a short-lived mTLS cert for the session if they want to avoid interception.

maria-sales: Customer asked if dedicated POC costs extra. For short trial no billing change; just operational tweak.

nina.sales: They want infra workaround (upgrade blocked). Window 48h, peak 8 rps.

omar-sre: Provisioned temp host poc-clearledger.redwood-temp.net -> 34.214.99.99, expires=48h. Also bumped their API-key window for trial.

redwood-deploy-bot: [info] Temp host created for customer=ClearLedger, host=poc-clearledger.redwood-temp.net, ip=34.214.99.99, expires=+48h.

nina.sales: Customer reports immediate improvement, 502s gone and timeouts reduced. Still see occasional 429 at spikes; omar can you monitor?

omar-sre: Monitoring. Will follow up if we need to adjust throughput.

rita-devex: For rerun after POC, give them this quick bypass snippet to skip proxy for our host:
```py
import os
os.environ['NO_PROXY'] = 'poc-clearledger.redwood-temp.net'
```

lee-security: I will add an entry to the security ticket explaining proxy-induced resets and the temporary mitigation for their questionnaire.

maria-sales: Nice. Leaving thread open for any follow-up SDK or security asks.
